li.label: browsed the market
li.description: I wandered past the stalls, fingered the cloth and argued about prices I had no intention of paying. Lovely afternoon.

li.label: bought something at the market
li.description: I bought something at the market. I probably did not need it. That is not the point.

li.label: went to the Great Fair
li.description: Bunting, crowds, six caravans and a man selling roasted nuts at a scandalous price. Our little town felt like a city for a day.

li.label: our stall won the fair
li.description: Six caravans of professional merchants, and the best stall at the fair was ours. Turnips, mostly. Very good turnips.

li.label: slave auction in town
li.description: People were sold on the block at our market today, the proper way, with bids and a gavel. Business as it should be.

li.label: slave auction in town
li.description: They sold people at our market today. I looked the other way. It did not help much.

li.label: slave auction in town
li.description: People were auctioned like cattle in our own market square. I keep hearing the bids.

li.label: slave auction in town
li.description: We let them sell human beings on a block in our town. What kind of place have we become?
